$comment: Moon's agent-mode definition, sent to TrueForge as an inline AgentSpec when a chat starts. Moon fills the {{...}} placeholders: {{model}} from config/moon.json (models.main, or models.backup on fallback), {{mcpServer}} with the agent endpoint's name (mcp.serverName + '-agent'), {{file:...}} with the text of that file (relative to this folder). The agent works in a hidden copy of the project: looking and editing never pause; run_command and apply_changes pause for the user's approval (apply_changes opens Moon's review screen).
